parameters.name: ChargingTime
parameters.tips:
1.Only filling the four period settings with all zero can disable force-charge period.
2.The following two checkboxes means:
 (checked) During force-charge period, both grid and PV can charge battery.
 (unchecked) During force-charge period, only PV can charge battery.
